items.title: PayPal cuts jobs in India and Ireland as it aims to simplify global operations
items.summary: Investing.com -- PayPal (NASDAQ: PYPL) has cut jobs in India and Ireland as part of a multi-year restructuring that is working through the payments group’s international offices.

items.title: 1 Stock Under $50 with Promising Prospects and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: Stocks in the $10-50 range offer a sweet spot between affordability and stability as they’re typically more established than penny stocks. But their headline prices don’t guarantee quality, and investors should exercise caution as some have shaky business models.

items.title: PayPal Cuts Around 600 Jobs in India, Moneycontrol Reports
items.summary: PayPal (NASDAQ:PYPL) has cut around 600 jobs in India, equivalent to approximately 10% of its workforce in the country, as part of a broader global restructuring, Moneycontrol reported on Thursday. According to people familiar with the matter cited by Moneycontrol, the reductions affected employees across technology, engineering, operations, payments and finance.

items.title: Affirm Rallies 6% on $104 Price Target From BofA, Sezzle Climbs 4%, PayPal Rises 3%
items.summary: Bank of America dropped a fresh price target on Affirm just as yields began to ease, and the combination sent buy-now-pay-later stocks racing ahead of a sleepy broad market. Whether the rally holds depends on a credit question Levchin himself flagged on live television.
